prior_adjudication.reason: Primary source identity is confirmed (Keith, Hartwig, & Richter, 2022, Collabra: Psychology, 8(1), DOI 10.1525/collabra.32964). The neutral description, p. 7 locator, and partial eta-squared metric uniquely identify the omnibus main effect of linguistic expression of gender on percentage of women listed (Hypothesis 1, F(3,340) = 20.50, p < .001, ηpartial2 = .15 in the full-sample one-way ANOVA, with the same main effect significant in the two-way ANOVA, F(3,332) = 23.99, p < .001, ηpartial2 = .18), which the authors explicitly report as replicating Stahlberg et al. (2001) Study 2.
